entries.not_relevant_because: The family concerns translational tiles of Z^3 and R^3 and the periodic tiling conjecture in dimension three. It constructs no two-dimensional prototile and says nothing about aperiodic-only tilings of the plane. Its only planar content is cited positive results: every finite tile of Z^2 admits a periodic tiling (Bhattacharya), and Greenfeld and Tao's structure theorem for tilings of Z^2 by one finite tile. The manuscript does not address whether any statement of the Einstein problem holds in R^2.

The family never mentions spectral sets, spectrality, or Fuglede's conjecture. Its subject is the periodic tiling conjecture for translational tiles of Z^3 and R^3. Tiling by translation is the only shared notion, and the manuscript does not connect it to spectrality of nonconvex sets in R or R^2. Its planar material is cited positive results on tilings of Z^2 and of rational polygonal sets, not spectral results.
